about: Framing presets (the shot form's Framing): a shot's `size:`, each with a sample picture of the same woman and street at that size (img/framing/<id>.jpg, made by tools/make_preset_samples.py). `id` is what the script's `size:` says (core/framing.py reads it); `hint` how much the frame holds; `prompt` what the sample is drawn from. A preset with `crop` has no render of its own: its sample is cut from another's render (`of`), `box` its left, top and width as fractions.

presets.label: Extreme close-up
presets.prompt: An extreme close-up: only her eyes and the bridge of her nose fill the whole frame, macro detail of her skin and lashes, nothing else visible

presets.label: Close-up
presets.prompt: A close-up: her face fills the frame from the top of her head to her chin, her shoulders just cut off

presets.label: Medium close-up
presets.prompt: A medium close-up of her, from the chest up

presets.label: Medium
presets.prompt: A medium shot of her, from the waist up

presets.label: Cowboy
presets.prompt: A cowboy shot: she is framed from the top of her head down to the middle of her thighs, her legs cut off at mid-thigh by the bottom of the frame

presets.label: Medium wide
presets.prompt: A medium-wide shot: she is framed from her head down to just below her knees, her shins cut off by the bottom of the frame, the street around her

presets.label: Full
presets.prompt: A full shot of her, her whole figure from head to toe

presets.label: Wide
presets.prompt: A wide shot: she stands small in the street, her whole figure about a third of the frame's height, the cafe, the tram stop and the street around her

presets.label: Extreme wide
presets.hint: the place, people small in it
presets.prompt: An extreme wide shot: she is small in the frame at the foot of a long street of tall buildings

presets.label: POV
presets.prompt: A first-person POV shot: we see only what she sees, walking up to a cafe door at a tram stop on a city street at dusk, her own hand in a red wool sleeve reaching out from the bottom of the frame toward the brass door handle; she herself is not in the picture

presets.label: Over the shoulder
presets.prompt: An over-the-shoulder shot: past the dark shoulder and back of a man's head in the foreground, she faces the camera

presets.label: Low angle
presets.prompt: A low-angle shot: a worm's-eye view from the wet pavement, the camera looking steeply up at her standing over it, the street lamps and the evening sky above her

presets.label: High angle
presets.prompt: A high-angle shot: the camera high above looking down on her standing alone on the wet pavement of the tram stop
